import json, subprocess, hashlib, sys
P='/app/submission/main.py'
ALI=['sip:alice@lab.test','sips:alice@lab.test','tel:+12025550100','sip:desk@lab.test']
def req(method='MESSAGE',target='sip:bob@lab.test',fr='sip:alice@lab.test',to=None,tag='a',call='x',cseq='1',cl=None,body=b'abc',extra=[], compact=False, rawheaders=None):
    if to is None: to=target
    if cl is None: cl=str(len(body))
    hs=[] if rawheaders is not None else [
      ('From',fr+';tag='+tag),('To',to),('Call-ID',call),('CSeq',cseq+' '+method),*extra,('Content-Length',cl)]
    if rawheaders is not None: hs=rawheaders
    s=(method+' '+target+' SIP/2.0\r\n'+''.join(n+': '+v+'\r\n' for n,v in hs)+'\r\n').encode('ascii')
    return s+body

def base(events=None,mode='access',privacy=None):
    if events is None: events=[req()]
    return {'version':1,'config':{'accounts':[{'id':'alice','default':ALI[0],'aliases':ALI},{'id':'bob','default':'sip:bob@lab.test','aliases':['sip:bob@lab.test']}], 'peers':[{'id':'p','mode':mode,'accounts':[] if mode=='access' else ['alice']}], 'ttl_ms':100,'capacity':2},'events':[{'t':i,'peer':'p','auth':None if mode=='relay' else 'alice','egress':'internal','wire_hex':w.hex() if isinstance(w,bytes) else w} for i,w in enumerate(events)]}
def run(doc):
    p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',P],input=json.dumps(doc).encode(),capture_output=True)
    try:o=json.loads(p.stdout) if p.stdout else None
    except:o=p.stdout
    return p.returncode,o,p.stderr

def one(w,**kw):
    rc,o,e=run(base([w],**kw)); assert rc==0,(rc,e); return o['results'][0]

# baseline and privacy projections
r=one(req()); assert r['decision']=='accept' and r['privacy']=='absent' and r['pai']==[ALI[0]] and r['from']==ALI[0]
r=one(req(extra=[('Privacy','id')])); assert r['from'].endswith('anonymous.invalid') and r['pai']==[ALI[0]]
d=base([req(extra=[('Privacy','id')])]); d['events'][0]['egress']='external'; r=run(d)[1]['results'][0]; assert r['pai']==[]
d=base([req(extra=[('Privacy','none')])]); d['events'][0]['egress']='external'; r=run(d)[1]['results'][0]; assert r['pai']==[ALI[0]]
# relay

# staging

r=one(req(rawheaders=[('From','x'),('To','x'),('Call-ID','x'),('CSeq','x'),('Content-Length','x')])); assert r['reason']=='length'
r=one(req(rawheaders=[('From','x'),('To','x'),('Call-ID','x'),('CSeq','x'),('Content-Length','3')])); assert r['reason']=='fields'
# unauth access fields wins
d=base([req(extra=[('Privacy','id;none')])]);d['events'][0]['auth']=None;r=run(d)[1]['results'][0];assert r['reason']=='fields'
d=base([req()]);d['events'][0]['auth']=None;r=run(d)[1]['results'][0];assert r['reason']=='auth'

# folding

# display quoted comma in PAI

for u in baduris:
